Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style gender swap bachelorettes to male bachelors Portraits and Sprites (CP)
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portraits and sprites of genderswap bachelorettes to male bachelors (Abigail, Emily, Haley, Leah, Maru, Penny). Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait. Including beach portraits and sprites.

Requested by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/15599024]ariasonata[/url]. Ariasonata is working on some gender swap dialogue rewrite for the default bachelorettes to bachelors mods rn, and I made portraits and character sprites for the gender-swapping.

This mod itself only includes portraits and sprites, [b]it does not include the dialogue swap and name changes. [/b]For the dialogue rework and name changes please wait for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/15599024]ariasonata[/url]﻿'s dialogue mod. [s]
[/s]
[size=3]For people who wants a dialogue mod to go with the portraits and sprites right now, I uploaded a quick simple [/size][size=3]gender swap name change and dialogue change mod:
[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9257][size=3]Gender swap bachelorettes to male bachelors dialogue (CP)
[/size][/url]

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/82887233]xIXApollyonXIx[/url] made a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271]Change villager and gender with ease[/url] mod, if you don't like the name I give them in my dialogue mod, Try use this instead, you can name them whatever you want with this mod :D (and with SVE name switch too check it out!)[/size]


Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. 
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]

I made [s]two [/s]versions. One is the Content Patcher version, Drag into [b]Stardew Valley\Mods [/b]to install.

The other version (in the optional file) is replacement files for people who have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] mod or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites[/url] mod installed already. To install find where you installed your DCBurger's Portrait and Slightly Cuter Characters mod (somewhere in [b]Stardew Valley\Mods folder[/b]). Drag the "assets" folder from my zip into the [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] DCBurger's High Res Portraits[/b] or [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Slightly Cuter Characters[/b] folder to overwrite the folder in it to install.
The replacement version prevents assets from getting loaded two times, choose whichever version you prefer/which Ever version that works for you.

Added a new version in the optional file for people who want to install the portraits with portraiture.

The original art style belongs to DCBurger: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66555116]tryptan[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites[/url] mod belongs to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
